questions.q: What comes next? BCD, EFG, HIJ, KLM, …
questions.why: Each group starts 3 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: NOP. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?
questions.why: These are the prime numbers in order. The next prime after 13 is 17.

questions.q: In a class of 100, 60% play cricket, 30% football and 10% both. How many play neither?
questions.why: At least one: 60 + 30 − 10 = 80; neither 20. GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: Meera is 6th from the top and 18th from the bottom in a class. How many students are in the class?
Find the next term in the series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.why: The first letter moves forward and the second moves backward: E and V.

questions.q: What comes next? FGH, IJK, LMN, OPQ, …
questions.why: Each group starts 3 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: RST. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 90 people, 42 like tea, 57 like coffee and 21 like both. How many like neither?

questions.why: Rice, wheat and maize are cereal grains. Cotton is a fibre crop.

questions.q: If TABLE is written as UBCMF in a certain code, how is CHAIR written?
questions.why: Each letter moves one place forward: C-D, H-I, A-B, I-J, R-S.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.why: The gaps grow by one each time: +2, +3, +4, +5, then +6. O is the 15th letter, so the next is the 21st, U.
